_comment: PER-BLOCK OVERRIDES. These BEAT the tag files - Burnt checks this list before any
burns_to_* tag, so use it when a block is already mapped and you disagree with it.
Adding a block to a different burns_to_* tag does NOT re-map it: tags MERGE, so the
block ends up in both and whichever tag Burnt checks first still wins.
'from' = any block id.  'to' = the Burnt block it should become.
Run /reload after editing. Unknown ids are skipped with a warning in the log.
